n: Model AI Assignments: AI and Employment Lesson Plan
t: A one hour discussion lesson on how AI may change work and jobs.
steps: Find the AI and Employment lesson on the Model AI Assignments site.
Download the teaching script, the slides, and the worksheets.
Prepare background on the 2023 Writers' Guild strike.
Plan about one hour, plus homework.
Decide whether students will present or write an essay afterward.
